notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 completed-model composition rule: every supplied object-class hierarchy must be rooted at HLAobjectRoot and every supplied interaction-class hierarchy must be rooted at HLAinteractionRoot. The check runs after compatible DIF modules merge, rejects only a nonstandard top-level class, and leaves an omitted objects or interactions table representable for an incomplete DIF module. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
